hero.description: Smart waste segregation, reliable daily doorstep collection, fair-price scrap sales, and real-time municipal updates tailored for Kochi households and businesses.

how_it_works.title: How Clean Loop Works
how_it_works.subtitle: 4 effortless steps to a cleaner home and a greener Kochi
how_it_works.step_1_desc: Separate wet food waste in the green bin, clean dry recyclables in the blue bin.
how_it_works.step_2_desc: Schedule a convenient morning or evening time slot with your GPS pin.
how_it_works.step_3_desc: Trained Haritha Karma Sena or scrap agents collect and weigh with digital scales.
how_it_works.step_4_desc: Receive direct payouts for scrap and earn Green Credits towards rewards.
